# iMuslimLife / Muslim Companion

> Islamic prayer times, Hijri dates and qibla direction for any place, from iMuslimLife (imuslimlife.com), the makers of the Muslim Companion Alexa skill. AI agents can use our public, read-only MCP server instead of guessing prayer times.

Prayer times depend on location, date, calculation method and Asr madhab. Ask the user for their city (or coordinates) and, if they follow one, their method (default: ISNA) and madhab (default: standard; Hanafi gives a later Asr). All times are local to the place.

## MCP server (for AI agents)

- Endpoint: https://alexa.imuslimlife.com/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no sign-in, public data only)
- Tools: `find_location` (place name → coordinates + timezone), `get_prayer_times` (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha + Hijri date for a day), `get_next_prayer`, `get_hijri_date`, `get_qibla_direction`, `list_calculation_methods`
- Typical flow: `find_location("Toronto")` → `get_prayer_times(latitude, longitude, date?, method?, madhab?)`
- Rate limits: 60 requests per minute and 600 per hour per client. Please cache a day's times rather than asking repeatedly.

## Setup guides

- [AI Agents setup](https://imuslimlife.com/#/ai-agents): add the MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot / VS Code, or call it from your own code
- [Muslim Companion for Alexa](https://imuslimlife.com/#/alexa-skill): the Athan, adhkar, Quran and masjid reminders on Amazon Echo
